violations.why: Timer_C (priority 4) can preempt Timer_A between its read and write of timerCount, so the increment is lost.
Timer_C can preempt Timer_A after its read at line 93 and reset timerCount. The check at line 95 then sees a different value.
Timer_C can preempt Timer_A between its write at line 93 and its read at line 95. It overwrites the value, so the check sees a value Timer_A did not write.
Timer_A (priority 3) can preempt Timer_B (priority 2) between its write of 0 and its check, so the check can see a nonzero value.
Timer_C can preempt Timer_B between its write and its read. It writes a value, and the check at line 108 reads that value instead of Timer_B's own.
Timer_Force (priority 3) can preempt Timer_B and set timerCount to 1. The check at line 108 then fails.
